title: Texas Housing Market Update Feb 2026: The REAL Problem No One is Talking About
description:
Thinking about buying or selling a home in Texas in 2026?
This video breaks down what’s actually happening in the Texas housing market — using real data, real buyer behavior, and on-the-ground insight from working with relocation buyers and sellers across the state.

We cover:

Current Texas home prices and where values are dropping

How long homes are really taking to sell (Days on Market)

Which Texas cities have the most price cuts (Austin, Dallas, San Antonio, Houston, Killeen–Fort Cavazos)

Why inventory levels matter for buyers

What sellers need to know to avoid chasing the market

How migration trends into Texas are impacting demand

What buyers are offering vs. what sellers are asking (list-to-sale price reality)

Whether you’re:

Relocating to Texas

Buying your first home

Selling a home in Central Texas

PCS’ing to Fort Cavazos / Killeen

Or trying to time the market the smart way

This video will help you understand where you actually have leverage — and where you don’t.

📍 Areas covered:
Texas statewide, Austin TX, Dallas–Fort Worth, Houston TX, San Antonio TX, Killeen–Temple–Fort Cavazos
